PAGES 6–9 · THE HUM

This uses the real "Rckly Suffix" loop as the literal hum from the text — not background music. A haptic pulse fires on every loop repeat (~8.52s), synced to the loop's real transient. Requires a tap to start (browser audio policy) and works best on a phone with vibration.
